dciP3ProfileNotes: JpegliIccProfiles.CreateDciP3Profile builds a fresh deterministic 536-byte perceptual ICC v4.4 RGB display profile from the P3/DCI/DCI branches of lib/cms/jpegli_cms_internal.h. P3 primaries are R=(0.680,0.320), G=(0.265,0.690), B=(0.150,0.060), with DCI white xy=(0.314,0.351) from lib/cms/color_encoding_cms.h. Shared serialization retains existing profiles; Bradford adaptation accepts the fixed DCI white in addition to its unchanged D65 default. Description RGB_DCI_DCI_Per_DCI; D50 wtpt, DCI-to-D50 chad, adapted colorants, shared type3 decoding curves [2.6,1,0,1,0] fixed-point [170394,65536,0,65536,0], and CICP [11,17,0,1]. Independently compiled unchanged pinned MSVC ARM64 C++17 /O2 /fp:strict fixture SHA256 D39C3009847419929E2746189C3EBC10B6DF93A7519A83C78D64A26778D94578 and ICC MD5 ID CFF4D77412057A38BA87E9CC1ED826FD. Explicit assignment for full-range samples already in DCI-P3 with gamma2.6, for RGB or corresponding YCbCr output. This differs from Display P3 D65/sRGB and does not describe cinema XYZ, grayscale or scaled XYB. No source conversion, automatic attachment or digital-cinema packaging; output remains lossy eight-bit JPEG. CICP lookup returns17 and preserves default quantization tuning. Independent native bytes, parsed curves, primary/Bradford oracles and encoding checks verify serialization and sample preservation without claiming a color-managed lossy JPEG quality comparison.

Explicit assignment for full-range samples already using the corresponding primaries and BT.709 transfer; no source conversion, limited-range expansion, tone mapping or automatic attachment. CICP lookup returns 1 and preserves existing quantization tuning. Independent native-byte, parsed curve/matrix and encoding checks validate serialization and sample preservation, without claiming a color-managed lossy JPEG quality comparison.

Explicit output-profile assignment only, for already linear-light samples; no source linearization, automatic attachment, source ICC management or change to encoder tuning. Independent tag/curve/matrix parsing, native hash fixtures and encoding checks validate serialization and sample preservation, not a color-managed lossy JPEG quality comparison.
srgbGrayscaleProfileNotes: JpegliIccProfiles.CreateSrgbGrayscaleProfile builds a fresh deterministic 328-byte perceptual ICC v4.4 grayscale display profile, porting the fixed D65/sRGB grayscale branch of lib/cms/jpegli_cms_internal.h. Header is mntr/GRAY/XYZ with D50 PCS illuminant; desc Gra_D65_Per_SRG, cprt CC0, D65 wtpt and type3 sRGB kTRC. It preserves the pinned builder's D65 media white and omission of chad/CICP rather than adapting that tag to D50. CIEXYZFromWhiteCIExy uses float reciprocal with double multiplication. Explicit IccProfile assignment for grayscale output with sRGB transfer only; no sample conversion, automatic attachment or source ICC management. Missing CICP yields unspecified transfer2 with opt-in lookup. Independent parsing, transfer-curve oracle and encoding checks validate profile bytes and embedding, not a color-managed lossy JPEG quality comparison.
xybProfileNotes: JpegliIccProfiles.CreateXybProfile builds a fresh deterministic 720-byte scaled XYB ICC v4.4 profile in managed code, porting the fixed D65/perceptual branch of lib/cms/jpegli_cms_internal.h and lib/cms/opsin_params.h. It contains desc XYB_Per, cprt CC0, wtpt, chad, A2B0 and compatibility B2A0 tags; forward conversion is a 2x2x2 linear CLUT, cubic curves and opsin-to-D50-XYZ matrix. B2A0 is identity, not an inverse for RGB-to-XYB conversion. Fixed upstream timestamp, flags, intent and MD5 profile ID retain reproducible bytes. Exact native profile SHA256 1F0B56AD33BD18343B89F0F3338306EF9B80F1860053A7F6B8C98B569C04064F was generated by compiling the unchanged pinned header. Callers explicitly assign IccProfile; no automatic attachment or source color management is provided. Independent parsing and forward-transform oracles validate the profile, not an end-to-end lossy JPEG color quality comparison.
progressiveSpectralBandNotes: Optional ProgressiveAcScanEnds defines a validated complete ordered partition of JPEG zigzag positions 1..63; null retains one full AC scan and existing JPEG bytes. Initial and refinement AC tokenization loops use inclusive spectral ranges, following lib/jpegli/entropy_coding.cc TokenizeACProgressiveScan and TokenizeACRefinementScan. Each round sends DC then bands outer/components inner; EOB state and restart cycling reset at every scan. Shared optimized AC histograms include all bands and refinement passes. Null ProgressiveAcRefinementBits uses the existing uniform ProgressiveRefinementBits. An explicit copied list sets each AC band depth0..10 while the scalar retains DC depth; refinement rounds descend from the maximum DC/AC depth, skipping completed ranges. Frequency collection follows the same AC passes. Ends[2,63], AC depths[0,2], DC depth0 match lib/jpegli/encode.cc SetDefaultScanScript level2 spectral/bit descriptors: DC and positions1..2 full precision, positions3..63 two deferred bits then refinement2-to1-to0. ProgressiveInterleaveDc defaults true, preserving interleaved MCU traversal and dummy blocks. False requires Progressive and sends each component's real blocks in raster order for initial and refinement DC, following encode.cc single-component MCU geometry and entropy_coding.cc TokenizeScan. Frequency collection has the same predictor resets and each component block counts as one restart MCU; RST numbering resets per scan. Grayscale bytes are unchanged. With those level2 bands and depths, false matches the upstream component/spectral/refinement schedule when either maximum sampling factor exceeds1; true matches its full-resolution interleaving rule. Managed SOS keeps unused table selectors zero, unlike pinned EncodeSOS; scan ordering does not establish encoder-byte or compression parity. List snapshot and validation precede output; final quantized coefficients remain unchanged.
xybConversionNotes: Explicit Xyb output also converts sRGB byte/ushort/float RGB, BGR, alpha layouts and replicated grayscale through direct normalized input, sign-preserving piecewise sRGB decoding, the pinned opsin matrix at intensity255 with finite biased absorbance clamped to zero, cube roots minus the bias root, then ScaleXYBRow constants and JPEG scaling. Normalization follows extras ToFloatRow double reciprocals for integers and unchanged source floats. MathF.Pow/Cbrt replace upstream rational/fast approximations, with native scalar fixtures allowing0.0025 JPEG sample units and an independent double oracle. Conversion reads on demand with bounded storage and applies before smoothing, sampling and Y-based AQ. Float nonlinear computations and out-of-range coefficients are validated before output. A caller-supplied matching scaled XYB output ICC remains required and opaque; a separate managed factory supplies the pinned perceptual profile, with no source ICC management. Automatic defaults and direct scaled XYB bytes are retained; YCbCr-to-XYB and XYB-to-other remain unsupported.
xybInputNotes: Xyb24/Xyb accept already ScaleXYBRow-scaled X/Y/B-minus-Y samples, using existing byte/ushort/float normalization. Automatic selects Xyb for this input; scaled XYB-to-other conversions are rejected. A nonempty caller ICC describing scaled XYB is required, embedded opaque and unchanged. These direct layouts bypass RGB linearization, opsin transform and XYB scaling; a separate managed factory provides the matching perceptual output profile. RGB container IDs R/G/B omit JFIF/Adobe, share Huffman0, but use separate perceptual XYB quantizers0/1/2 with global scale1.43951668 and nonlinear distance scaling. Standard-table/CICP hints do not alter quantization; default factors2x2/2x2/1x1 ignore the preset. Custom factors map X/Y/B-minus-Y, with AQ on unsmoothed Y, disabled when Y is subsampled, using RGB uniform0.5 AC multipliers/offsets and zero disabled bias. Existing smoothing/edge/progressive/refinement/restart/metadata and finite coefficient preflight paths apply. This does not establish color-managed roundtrip or full encoder parity.
outputColorSpaceNotes: ColorSpace Automatic preserves existing grayscale/YCbCr defaults and selects Xyb for scaled XYB input. Explicit Grayscale converts RGB luminance or consumes only Y from direct YCbCr; YCbCr output accepts grayscale with neutral 128 chroma, deliberately differing from the pinned GrayscaleToYCbCr zero-fill helper. RGB preserves normalized R/G/B layouts or replicates grayscale, rejects direct YCbCr input, emits R/G/B IDs without JFIF/Adobe, and uses shared Annex K luma quantizer 0 and Huffman 0. RGB defaults to 1x1 regardless preset; custom Luma/Cb/Cr factors map to R/G/B. AQ analyzes green, disables for subsampled green and uses uniform 0.5 AC multipliers/offsets; disabled RGB bias is 0. Transfer hints and UseStandardQuantizationTables do not change RGB output. This extends normalized BGR/alpha layouts beyond upstream RGB transform support, adds no profile generation or color management, and RGB output does not perform the separately available explicit Xyb conversion.
iccTransferLookupNotes: Opt-in InferCicpTransferFunctionFromIccProfile applies only when CicpTransferFunction is 2; every explicit non-2 code overrides lookup. Ported from FindCICPTag and LookupCICPTransferFunctionFromICCProfile in lib/extras/enc/jpegli.cc: complete directory, last cicp entry, declared size >=12, readable first12 payload bytes with cicp type, transfer at byte9. Invalid or absent lookup falls back2 and ICC embedding remains unchanged. Header fields, other CICP fields, reserved bytes and declared extent beyond12 are not validated, matching the raw helper. Unlike upstream's uint32 count arithmetic, bounds use division before indexing to prevent overflow. Constant working storage and periodic cancellation, no profile transform or generation.
transferFunctionNotes: CicpTransferFunction defaults to 2 (unspecified) and accepts 0..255, rejecting aliases that upstream's int setter would narrow to uint8_t. Codes 16 (PQ) and 18 (HLG) multiply perceptual global scale by 0.4 and 0.5 before 4:2:0 compensation. Other codes preserve default tuning. QuantValsToDistance uses the same transfer scale without 4:2:0 compensation, including standard shared-chroma selectors; standard table generation itself ignores the hint. No sample conversion, color management, CICP marker or automatic profile is provided, and eight-bit output does not establish HDR conformance.
standardQuantizationNotes: Opt-in UseStandardQuantizationTables uses the pinned quant.cc Annex K luma and shared chroma matrices, scaled by 0.01 * DistanceToLinearQuality(resolved distance), rounded and clamped to 1..255 without 4:2:0 compensation. Clamping precedes integer conversion, including immediately below distance 25 where upstream's conversion overflows; native parity is not claimed for that edge. Color emits table IDs 0/1 and frame selectors 0/1/1; grayscale emits only 0. Adaptive inference uses upstream quant_tbl_no indexing, including the perceptual Cb base for both chroma components, while zero-bias multipliers remain component-specific. This is not libjpeg byte or quality parity; the default retains perceptual tables and existing bytes.
distanceNotes: Optional positive finite Distance overrides Quality while keeping Quality validation. Null uses the public fractional QualityToDistance polynomial and preserves existing bytes. The resolved distance controls table generation in all input and scan paths; adaptive multipliers remain table-derived. Tables clamp to baseline 1..255 even at finite float extremes; upstream C++ overflow behavior at such extremes is not a parity claim. Distance is not a measured or guaranteed perceptual error, and encoding remains lossy.
iptcNotes: Raw opaque IPTC-IIM data is embedded in one Photoshop APP13 resource 0x0404 with an empty Pascal name, unsigned big-endian unpadded data length and even-byte padding. The single-marker input limit is 65,506 bytes. No IIM validation, text conversion, digest resource or XMP/Exif reconciliation is performed.
automaticXmpNotes: Opt-in oversized standard packets move their full XML root into extended XMP with a generated digest-only standard packet by default. StandardXmpProperties can retain complete selected top-level attributes and elements in a compact standard envelope, preserving inherited namespaces and XML attributes, with pre-output validation of its final UTF-8 size including the digest link. Parsing requires ordinary empty-subject XMP envelopes and uses packet-sized storage. Smaller and manually partitioned packets retain their existing bytes.
samplingNotes: Integer sample areas use frame-wide component factor maxima, including subsampled luma with adaptive quantization disabled as upstream. Three-row areas include all three rows; the pinned ChooseDownsampleMethods instead selects two-row kernels for vertical factor 3.
floatInputNotes: Out-of-range float input is opt-in and retains samples without clipping. Unlike upstream coefficient storage, a bounded preflight requires finite scaling and computation, rounded DC -1024..1023 and AC -1023..1023 before output, independently of scan or Huffman settings.
srgbProfileNotes: JpegliIccProfiles.CreateSrgbProfile builds a fresh deterministic 504-byte perceptual ICC v4.4 RGB display profile, porting the fixed D65/sRGB branch of lib/cms/jpegli_cms_internal.h with precise primaries from lib/cms/color_encoding_cms.h. Tags include desc sRGB, cprt CC0, D50 wtpt, D65-to-D50 Bradford chad, cicp [1,13,0,1], adapted rXYZ/gXYZ/bXYZ and rTRC/gTRC/bTRC sharing one type3 parametric sRGB decoding curve. Canonical adapted float colorants are precomputed from the unchanged upstream builder; shared managed serialization preserves XYB profile bytes. Fixed upstream timestamp, flags, intent and MD5 ID retain reproducible bytes. Exact native profile SHA256 1406EFC5429250FEBE778C182EB5E5168AA14B2CAEFCF772211A2EC2ECF31659 and ID A3379298068DF11976289D87A33230AA were generated by compiling the unchanged pinned header with MSVC C++17 /fp:strict. Explicit IccProfile assignment only; describes sRGB RGB interpretation of RGB or YCbCr output, not grayscale or scaled XYB. No sample conversion, source ICC management or automatic attachment. Independent tag/curve/matrix parsing and sRGB-to-D50-XYZ oracles validate the profile, not an end-to-end lossy JPEG quality comparison.
displayP3ProfileNotes: JpegliIccProfiles.CreateDisplayP3Profile builds a fresh deterministic 516-byte perceptual ICC v4.4 RGB display profile by porting the fixed P3/D65/sRGB-transfer branches of lib/cms/jpegli_cms_internal.h, with P3 primaries from lib/cms/color_encoding_cms.h: R=(0.680,0.320), G=(0.265,0.690), B=(0.150,0.060). Shared Internal/RgbIccProfile serialization preserves existing sRGB and linear-sRGB bytes. Tags include desc DisplayP3, cprt CC0, D50 wtpt, D65-to-D50 Bradford chad, adapted colorants, CICP [12,13,0,1] and shared type3 sRGB decoding curves. Canonical adapted float colorants come from the unchanged pinned builder. Fixed upstream timestamp, flags, perceptual intent and MD5 ID retain reproducible bytes. Explicit output-profile assignment only, for already Display P3 samples in RGB or YCbCr output; no sample conversion, gamut mapping, automatic attachment or source ICC color management. Independent native-byte comparison, tag/curve/matrix oracles and encoding checks validate serialization and sample preservation, not a color-managed lossy JPEG quality comparison.
rec2100ProfileNotes: JpegliIccProfiles.CreateRec2100PqProfile and CreateRec2100HlgProfile build fresh deterministic 4344-byte perceptual ICC v4.4 RGB display profiles from the fixed Rec2020/D65 PQ and HLG branches of lib/cms/jpegli_cms_internal.h with default JPEGLI_ENABLE_3D_ICC_TONEMAPPING=1. Descriptions RGB_D65_202_Per_PeQ and RGB_D65_202_Per_HLG; Lab PCS, D50 wtpt, D65-to-D50 Bradford chad, shared existing Rec2020 adapted colorants, CICP [9,16,0,1] or [9,18,0,1]. A2B0 is mft1 with identity matrix, 256-entry identity input/output curves and a 9x9x9 eight-bit RGB-to-Lab CLUT. PQ decodes at 10000 nits then applies the pinned BT.2408 mapper to 250 nits; HLG applies the pinned 300-to-80-nit OOTF adjustment. Both apply scalar gamut mapping with preservation weight 0.3 before D50 Lab conversion. B2A0 is an identity compatibility mBA tag, not an inverse. Numerical helpers port float/double evaluation order from transfer_functions.h and tone_mapping.h. Independently compiled unchanged pinned MSVC ARM64 C++17 /O2 /fp:strict fixture: PQ SHA256 B2F97E195A8C64DD55EFF71FC1DF480A12E59D71105D7D9DABFCC23F9252C48E and ID 22BC30F3E3B03923D34FE5CF368CCFA6; HLG SHA256 CB3A3012517E21922D895462F66841F6EDEDDE8031CC3CD3041A12AF8536A556 and ID D2BA1D3F609E15C6612C1CDE2CC98D15. Explicit output-profile assignment for already full-range Rec2100 samples, RGB or corresponding YCbCr output; no source conversion, limited-range expansion, encoder tone mapping or automatic attachment. Opt-in CICP inference selects existing PQ/HLG tuning in YCbCr paths; explicit transfer hints override it. A compatible display CMM may use the tone-mapping LUT or CICP directly. Output remains lossy eight-bit JPEG and profile embedding does not establish HDR display or Rec2100 conformance.
additionalGrayscaleProfileNotes: JpegliIccProfiles.CreateRec709GrayscaleProfile, CreateDciGrayscaleProfile, CreateRec2100PqGrayscaleProfile and CreateRec2100HlgGrayscaleProfile build fresh deterministic perceptual ICC v4.4 grayscale display profiles from the GRAY branches of lib/cms/jpegli_cms_internal.h. Shared Internal/GrayscaleIccProfile serialization preserves existing sRGB and linear grayscale bytes. Rec709/DCI are 328 bytes with type3 BT.709 or gamma2.6 decoding curves; PQ/HLG are 436 bytes with 64-entry curv tables. Descriptions Gra_D65_Per_709, Gra_DCI_Per_DCI, Gra_D65_Per_PeQ and Gra_D65_Per_HLG. All retain source media white (D65 except DCI xy=(0.314,0.351)), D50 XYZ PCS header and four tags desc/cprt/wtpt/kTRC; no chad, CICP, colorants or 3D LUT. HDR table generation follows CreateTableCurve<64> float grid i/63, double transfer arithmetic returning float via copysignf, double scaling by65535 followed by roundf; CanToneMap=false for grayscale so PQ remains normalized to10000 nits and HLG has no OOTF. Independently compiled unchanged pinned MSVC ARM64 C++17 /O2 /fp:strict fixtures: Rec709 SHA256 2955B00FF8629C6C518509DC1F31279828D00508B096F4EB9565D271849CBB81 and ID40AB32E3684939CF0CB29EB2C82798F5; DCI SHA256 E3D49DE1DEE11786DBA14DE3F273B1CBBC86FD5501F3DC42CD393F737ACE82FB and IDC20C5B4FA3DD24109E6DA3D52288B148; PQ SHA256 1F25816054A452DD533EF8F56203506387A9521474225B59DEB3D8D91F51BF58 and ID5713614D083B44B7CEA46698FE2DAF5F; HLG SHA256 0EA7002A458B45560E4FA1B9FA8B99115C2CFB5468DCA8FE494480E6D093E013 and ID6B40A764E4E988F46E9F399DE140CA8C. Explicit output-profile assignment for already full-range transfer-encoded grayscale samples; no source conversion, limited-range expansion, automatic attachment or encoder tone mapping. Missing CICP lookup returns2 and preserves default tuning; explicit16/18 still request existing PQ/HLG quantization hints. Independent native bytes, parsed transfer curves/tables and encoding checks validate serialization and sample preservation without claiming color-managed lossy JPEG quality, HDR display, Rec2100 or digital-cinema conformance.
